fields.replying_to: Replying to FALSA: Fairness-Aware Latent Space Alignment in Vision-Language Models for Medical Image Segmentation

fields.display_title: FALSA introduces three novel, complementary components (DICL, AFC, UniFairLoss) that go beyond prior fairness methods. New MIMIC-CXR experiments show consistent gains in Dice/IoU, ES-Dice, and AUROC, and significant reductions in GSD across intersectional groups. Covariance and leakage analyses confirm actual fairness improvements. Statistical tests show FALSA boosts fairness without harming, and often improving accuracy.

fields.display_title: FALSA introduces three complementary components (DICL, AFC, UniFairLoss) that provide principled multimodal debiasing while preserving task-relevant features. It handles intersectional bias via covariance-based losses and multi-label AFC, stable even with small groups. New MIMIC-CXR and zero-shot results show consistent accuracy, fairness, and AUROC gains. FALSA improves performance by reducing demographic shortcuts.
